variants.title: Making an ammeter from a galvanometer
variants.aim: Find the resistance and the figure of merit of a galvanometer by half deflection, work out the shunt that makes it a 0 - 0.3 A ammeter, and calibrate it against a standard ammeter.

source.title: University of Delhi B.Sc. (Hons.) Physics practical lists (LOCF 2019 / UGCF 2022)
